name: Stinking Up Southshore

guaranteedRewards.name: Hallow's End Pumpkin Treat
tooltip: Use: Enjoy a tasty Hallow's End treat! Better eat it quick before they go bad... (1 Min Cooldown)

narrative.details:
Celebrate Hallow's End in style... by bringing grief to our enemies in Southshore!

Take one of these specially crafted stink bombs.  It is filled with an odiferous funk that no human - or any weak-willed beast for that matter - can stand to smell.  You'll need to throw it right in the heart of Southshore for it to do its job, so be prepared for a fight against the Alliance!

When you've completed this task... this tribute to our liberation, return to me!
narrative.objectives: Toss three Forsaken Stink Bombs into the heart of Southshore in Hillsbrad, and return to Darkcaller Yanka at the Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, well done! I hope the Alliance chokes on the foul gift we've given them, much like we were forced to choke on the yoke of enslavement to the Scourge!

You've kept the ideas of Hallow's End true, adventurer, and for that I salute you. As an extra bonus, let me share some of these Hallow's End treats I have with you. I think you might find them to be quite the enjoyable diversion!
narrative.requestItemsText:
Have you delivered our "gift" to the people of Southshore?

<Darkcaller Yanka laughs wickedly.>
